title: Complete idempotent operation results, pending-intent recovery and typed errors

checkpoint.summary: Persisted canonical operation inputs and immutable original write receipts (path/content identities) in the same ledger commit, replayed across clones after further writes. Added private local pending-intent journaling for task/review/integration MCP mutations, offline-readable pending inbox, typed V2 ledger failure transport with operation IDs, and jittered retry. Remaining: domain-specific original results, confirmed-origin commit proof, outstanding-journal reconciliation and full contention/transport tests.
checkpoint.nextAction: Finish exact domain-specific operation result schemas and journal reconciliation/acknowledgment; then test ambiguous remote push responses, 8-writer contention and structured observed-head error metadata.
